# Sarvahit Seva Trust (सर्वहित सेवा ट्रस्ट)

> "सेवा | सहयोग | मानवता | जनकल्याण" — Dedicated to human service, healthcare, education, environmental protection, women empowerment, and holistic societal development.

## About Organization
- **Official Name**: Sarvahit Seva Trust (सर्वहित सेवा ट्रस्ट)
- **Legal Registration No.**: UP/2026/1144009 (Government of Uttar Pradesh, India)
- **Founder / National President**: Shiv Prakash Singh (शिव प्रकाश सिंह)
- **Headquarters Address**: Gram Lahua Khurd, Post Palhna, Tehsil Lalganj, District Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh - 276202, India
- **Official Helpline**: +91 89530 78333
- **Official Email**: sarvhitsevatrust@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://sarvahitsevatrust.com

## Core Initiatives & Welfare Pillars
1. **Education Support (शिक्षा)**: Providing school kits, tuition assistance, and learning resources to underprivileged students.
2. **Healthcare & Medical Relief (स्वास्थ्य)**: Free medical camps, health check-ups, and essential medicine distribution in rural areas.
3. **Environmental Protection (पर्यावरण)**: Massive tree plantation drives, water conservation, and clean & green village initiatives.
4. **Social Assistance (सामाजिक सहायता)**: Relief supplies, emergency aid, and winter blanket distribution for needy families.
5. **Women Empowerment (महिला सशक्तिकरण)**: Self-reliance workshops, vocational training, and legal & health awareness programs.
6. **Cultural Values (संस्कार एवं संस्कृति)**: Preserving community values, heritage, and moral education for youth.
